elements.element: Expiry or termination of the Agreement triggers the transition obligations.
elements.evidence: The clause applies “[u]pon expiration or termination of this Agreement for any reason.”

elements.element: HDI must provide transition assistance to the Company.
elements.evidence: HDI “shall ... at the Company's request, provide transition assistance.”

elements.element: Transition assistance must be available for up to six months.
elements.evidence: The assistance is expressly available “for up to six (6) months.”

elements.element: Transition assistance must be provided at HDI's then-current rates.
elements.evidence: The clause specifies “at HDI's then-current rates.”

elements.element: HDI must return Company Data to the Company.
elements.evidence: HDI must return all defined “Company Data” to the Company.

elements.element: Company Data must be returned within 30 days after expiry or termination.
elements.evidence: Return is required “within thirty (30) days after such expiration or termination.”

elements.element: Company Data must be returned in a standard machine-readable format.
elements.evidence: The clause expressly requires a “standard machine-readable format.”

elements.element: HDI must delete Company Data after returning it.
elements.evidence: After return, HDI must “delete Company Data from its systems.”

elements.element: HDI must certify deletion after returning and deleting Company Data.
elements.evidence: HDI must “certify such deletion in writing to the Company” after return.

elements.element: Expiry or termination of the Agreement triggers the fallback transition obligations.
elements.evidence: The clause applies “[u]pon expiration or termination of this Agreement for any reason.”

elements.element: HDI must provide transition assistance to the Company.
elements.evidence: HDI “shall ... at the Company's request, provide transition assistance.”

elements.element: Transition assistance must be available for at least 90 days.
elements.evidence: Availability for up to six months encompasses the 90-day fallback period.

elements.element: HDI must export or return Company Data to the Company.
elements.evidence: HDI must return all defined Company Data in a standard machine-readable format.

elements.element: The Company Data export must occur within 30 days after expiry or termination.
elements.evidence: The data return is required within 30 days after expiration or termination.

result.reason: The operative clause fully implements the preferred position and therefore also meets the fallback. It specifies the correct trigger, responsible party, assistance duration and rates, 30-day machine-readable data return, subsequent deletion, and written certification. The amendment is confined to transition and data-return mechanics and does not alter unrelated commercial terms.
